verdict.rationale: Formant documents a built-in AI assistant that helps users build analytics dashboards. Its product page says users can ask the fleet questions in plain language and receive ML-driven task recommendations that people approve. Delegation is therefore limited to dashboard building and human-approved recommendations. The 'Formant agent' items describe device software, not an AI assistant, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what tasks the assistant can actually perform, evidence of autonomous task execution beyond recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.
Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
